item.title: Version 1.1.26
item.description: What’s New 1. Role-Based Access on Deals: Deal information is now displayed based on user permissions, with full access for Superusers and restricted access for other users. 2. Improved Top Deals Search: Search Top Deals by Deal ID, Operator Name, or Alliance Name. Partial and full Deal ID searches are now supported, with direct access to Deal Details. 3. Stability & Performance: Improved overall app stability, performance, security, and reliability across Deals, Dashboard, Notifications, and Authentication.

item.title: Version 1.1.21
item.description: What’s New 1. Added role-based access control on Country and Operator Details pages, so users only see data based on their permissions. 2. Improved multiple network display in Deal Details. The app now shows the first 3 networks and a “+ X” count for additional networks. 3. Fixed discount value formatting in Deal Details. Percentage and IVC discounts no longer show currency symbols, while amount-based discounts show the correct currency.
